# Jm Castillo — Mix & Mastering Engineer

> Jm Castillo (Juan Manuel Castillo, "Kstillo") is a mixing and mastering engineer and music producer born in Seville, Spain, with 15+ years of experience. Projects he mixed and mastered have earned 37 Platinum records, 38 Gold records and 3 Odeon Awards (Best Flamenco Song 2026 and 2025 for Luis Cortés; Best Urban Album 2023 for "Nastu" by RVFV). He mixed and mastered "Mi Luz" by RVFV & Rels B (8x Platinum) and has worked with RVFV, Rels B, David Bisbal, Camilo, Duki, Anitta, Lola Indigo, India Martínez, Luis Cortés, Morad and Omar Montes, and with labels including Warner, Universal, Sony, Virgin, Spinnin' Records, Toolroom and Altafonte. 800+ songs mixed, 4,000M+ accumulated streams. Online service, Spanish and English.

## Rates (per song, EUR, VAT not included, 3–5 business days)
- Full Mix/Mastering (mix + master): 300 € — up to 3 revisions
- Pro Mix/Master: 400 € — mix stems, production arrangements, priority, up to 10 revisions
- Full Mix: 250 € · Vocal Mix: 150 € · Beat Mix: 150 €
- Mastering only: 100 € · Stem Mastering: 150 €
Payment before the project starts.

## File delivery
WAV ≥ 44.1 kHz / 24-bit, separate tracks, uncompressed master, peaks ≤ −6 dB, no reverb/delay/compression on tracks. Send a Drive/WeTransfer link to stems@jmcastillo.es.

## Contact
info@jmcastillo.es · WhatsApp +34 623 040 053 (Mon–Fri 8:00–15:00 CET) · https://jmcastillo.es/contacto/
